name: @meowshed/meow-csharp
description: Detects a .NET solution or project from what git tracks, compares the SDK global.json pins with the ones installed, prints a stages table that restores explicitly and keeps every build's output outside the working tree, reports Nullable, TreatWarningsAsErrors and AnalysisLevel left unset, writing no file, and carries what a reviewer of C# checks that no command reports. Distributed as a Pi package.
